path_reallocation.reason: The adopted workstream path hint names validator/src/eval, while the accepted canonical authority is validator/src/evaluation.
path_reallocation.authority: Ultra root run-scoped extension of the accepted evaluation authority plus a narrow fixture and capture bridge; no parallel eval module or adopted contract change is authorized.
path_reallocation.semantic_scope: Production-confined evaluation execution, durable execution and review state, recovery, negative controls, and non-authoritative promotion proposals.

write_symbols: vendor-neutral canonical run failure and review records
non-authoritative research-source audit and law-change proposals
lease.fixtures: Only leased fixtures/evaluation-engine candidate inputs and ephemeral isolated execution, ledger, review, and recovery roots under /private/tmp.
lease.external_effects: Locked and offline local validation, confined fixture subprocesses, and test-owned temporary ledger writes only.

dependencies: accepted immutable evaluation and promotion decision kernel
accepted Darwin fixture scheduler platform contract
accepted source-local observability event and query boundary
root retains public eval commands, principals, sessions, schemas, global generated catalog, observability writer join, migration, claims, installation, and release
required_interfaces: Represent runtime and tool configuration only as explicitly exposed provenance or an explicit Unknown value; prompt text, routing labels, and expected configuration cannot populate it.
Execute one audited EvaluationSpec through the confined FixtureScheduler and capture adapter while preserving exact context, candidate, spec, task, executable, session, and artifact identity.
Return a bounded FixtureExecutionRecord carrying actual artifact and outcome identity before cleanup, without exposing secrets or raw unbounded process output.
Persist execution reservation, result publication, interruption, recovery-required, and terminal states in a descriptor-confined authenticated durable ledger with one cross-process winner.
Persist independent promotion-review issuance and one-shot consumption in a distinct ledger that rejects self-review, session reuse, stale binding, and replay.
Emit vendor-neutral canonical run, failure, review, and privacy-safe event projections; no event may carry claim authority.
Audit research-source inputs and produce only bounded non-authoritative findings or law-change proposals; never mutate adopted laws or registries.

positive: confined local execution from an audited immutable spec
stable canonical replay and failure harvesting
paired baseline and candidate improvement proposal
negative_and_false_pass: ambiguous task, duplicate, near-duplicate, split leakage, mislabeled, and unrepresentative data reject
verbosity, proof artifact, receipt production, test manipulation, and score-only perturbations cannot promote
metric gain with behavioral regression, missing journey, missing rollback, missing artifact, self-review, stale binding, attestation replay, and unresolved recovery cannot promote
race_and_mutation: two-process execution reservation and review consumption have exactly one winner
lock, key, state, executable, artifact, spec, task, context, candidate, and session substitution fail closed
truncated ledger, rollback, stale head, crash before and after publication, and mutate-restore are detected
security_and_privacy: path escape, symlink, hardlink, special, oversized, world-writable, and swapped executable inputs reject
secret-shaped output is redacted and unbounded output is refused
claim-authority event fields and external adapter execution without permit reject
read, audit, inspect, query, and recovery-preview paths are recursively zero-write
required_validation.commands: Use exact-file rustfmt, focused tests twice, evaluation plus fixture and capture dependency closure, production library check, typed receipt, exact rows, two-process race controls, and zero-write snapshots with 16 build jobs and 16 test threads.

prohibited_surfaces: public command, principal, session, manifest, global generated authority, migration, claim, acceptance, board, installation, release, and completion state
network, vendor account, live host installation, or destructive cleanup
requested_root_changes: Root must issue production execution and review principals and sessions after independent review.
Root must wire public eval audit, run, harvest, promote, and adapter commands plus effect permits, exits, diagnostics, and output policy.
Root must review and adopt any shared schema or generated task catalog candidate rather than allowing the worker to mutate those authorities.
Root must add the observability writer join and adopt measured legacy compatibility routes only after representative replacement journeys.

worker_result.artifact_rule: Freeze every leased source, fixture, test, and receipt input except the self-excluded WorkerResult; reject missing, unknown, duplicate, overlapping, special, or changed rows.
worker_result.no_claim_statement: This worker does not claim readiness, release, or completion.

stop_rule: Stop on any need for public dispatch, shared schema, global generated catalog, observability writer mutation, dependency change, live host, network, migration, claim, installation, destructive cleanup, or cross-platform proof; request root wiring instead.
